name: Ap chao
summary: Bánh áp chao is an afternoon fried cake. One article says the filling is duck. An earlier article says marinated meat and does not say duck. A clock and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Cao Bang city, in the afternoon.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026: it looks at first like a savory fried cake, the filling is duck, the shell is golden and crisp, the inside is soft, and it is eaten with herbs, shredded green papaya, and a sweet-sour dip.
The 3 May 2026 article describes marinated meat in a soft batter, fried golden, crisp outside and soft and chewy inside, with herbs and a sweet-sour dip, and does not say the meat is duck.
The September article says afternoon hours in the town center can change by the day. A clock and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Afternoon counters in the town center. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on 22 August 2024 says bánh áp chao was chosen for a top 100 Vietnamese dish list. Come for an afternoon counter in the center.
